steps.content: You arrive at a crossroads, the sight of which makes you feel somewhat familiar. You realize this seems to be the place where you were rescued by Vanilla.
Unlike before, you now have experience dealing with monsters, and the armor made by Vanilla herself. You are somewhat tempted, thinking whether you can explore further.
Of course, you don't recklessly venture into the area, instead, you take out the telescope attached on your waist.
Although you were mentally prepared, you still gasp after you look into the telescope.

The monster you just fought is one of the most difficult ones to deal with so far. The fight wasn't easy at all. But now you see the same monsters in hordes. You can't even count their number at a glance.

Behind the monsters are those twisted glimmers and the storm, the gigantic shadow within the storm is barely visible. It resembles a leviathan patrolling its territory, blocking everything from approaching.
Just then, the pocket watch hanging on your chest suddenly vibrates—it's Vanilla.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: You're taking longer than usual. Where are you? Did you run into trouble?
She falls silent for a while.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Okay, as long as you're not in danger. I think it's better for you to come back now. We can talk when you're back.
Vanilla's voice gives you peace of mind. After hanging up, you take a deep breath and start analyzing the situation.
It seems that the military mech you and Vanilla are building is indispensable. Without it, you can't possibly break through the blockade of the monsters.
Now that you've collected enough supplies. It's time to head back.
